mapper.select: SELECT id, phone, email, phone_verified, email_verified FROM t_profiles WHERE id=#{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM t_verification_codes WHERE target=#{target} AND channel=#{channel} AND code=#{code} AND used=0 AND expires_at>NOW(3) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_verification_codes SET used=1 WHERE id=#{codeId} AND used=0 AND expires_at>NOW(3)

UPDATE t_profiles
SET phone=#{target}, phone_verified=1 SET email=#{target}, email_verified=1
WHERE id=#{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
